# netactuate_router_routing_view (Resource)

Beta. The cloud router family is in beta: behaviour and schema may change. Requests routing views from a VRF.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_router_routing_view" "example" {
  router_id = 12345
  view {
    ip_version = 4
    name       = "example"
  }
  vrf_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (Number) Cloud router ID.
- `view` (Block List, Min: 1) Routing views to request from the router. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--view))
- `vrf_id` (Number) VRF ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `result_json` (String) Requested routing views as compact JSON.

<a id="nestedblock--view"></a>
### Nested Schema for `view`

Required:

- `ip_version` (Number) IP version for the routing view.
- `name` (String) Routing view name.

Optional:

- `filter` (String) Optional routing view filter.
- `view_id` (String) Optional caller supplied view ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_router_routing_view.example 12345
```
